headline: Changes to school policies, including striking three facilities policies, adopting a travel reimbursement policy, and reviewing 16 policies.
summary: The agenda covers policies to strike, adopt, and review. Main topics include school facilities use and fees, travel expense reimbursement, student athletics rules, and bloodborne pathogens.
